The record's disciplined honesty is precisely what makes its surviving claims credible; nothing here bears on nature.

points.title: The foundations positioning is structurally unfalsifiable: absorbable nulls, an idealized-screen conditional, and an undemonstrated far-field null

The sharpest discriminator (POVM exclusion) is testbed-grade, single-configuration, ensemble-based (Π < 1.5×10⁻³ at 95% CL, not Π = 0), and conditional on the non-perturbing screen idealization: a physical absorbing detector is itself POVM-describable, so the exclusion may evaporate exactly where it would be measured. Meanwhile the far-field null the Layer-1 envelope needs FAILED at its pre-registered d=25 (p = 9.9×10⁻⁸) with no passing d ever scored, and the analytic theorem's core obligation O-1 has, by the campaign's own statement, no identified technology.

points.title: Process: 'external replication' is not independent — one actor class writes the corpus, the tests, the verdicts, and the folds
points.argument: The corpus, the replication campaign, the adjudications, and the corpus3 editions are all produced by the same actor system (Claude sessions in one repository, one coordinator persona); no human or organizationally distinct party has re-run anything. points.title: Process: the findings are terminally undischargeable — the counterparty does not exist, the replicators now write the corpus, and 'complete' never means complete

verdicts.reason: family_ADJUDICATION.md item 2 (F-R6) states the chain is 'arithmetically false as written' (2.9 → ×2 → +14% = 6.61 ≠ 5.6; closure needs −3.4%, more than 3× the printed ±5%); family_RESULTS.md T5-F1 line 65 confirms printed ±0.9/±1.2 are '30-35% smaller' than the forced σ_A ≥ 1.37 / σ_B ≥ 1.68, 'impossible under exact rescaling plus uncertain corrections', all 8 readings failing. Paper VII.H confirms the ×1.9 magnitude miss with E-F1's exact ×2 'caught one block later' (post-hoc). The quark-belt composition rule R = 1 + B_geo/A − B_tube/A is explicitly 'unprinted... uniquely pinned by the printed numbers' with the direct-m_t scheme pinned because 'MS-bar fails the R pull' (family_RESULTS line 82), and the tier audits 'everything downstream of the printed Σ(p) integral values' — the arithmetic perimeter only. One nuance the point omits (the adjudication grades F-R6 direction-neutral, not a favorable fudge) does not touch any stated claim.

verdicts.point_title: The 0νββ insert is broken within-model by 14-18 orders of magnitude, with every rescue route closed or costly
verdicts.reason: N2/RESULTS.md sec 0 verifies every number: R = 1.1×10¹⁴-8.9×10¹⁷ at the four anchors, self-averaging to relative width ≤ 5×10⁻⁴ (making R the sample observable), g_equiv = √R·g = 8.5×10⁻³-12.3, and route (i) 'closed by arithmetic' with the retreat overshooting 'the corpus's own printed ε-ceiling 2.604×10⁻³ by 14-18 orders'. M3/RESULTS.md rules route (b) NOT-VIABLE under the pre-registered rule via an amplitude-support argument that is saturation-shape-robust. O2/GLIM_ARCHAEOLOGY.md confirms the conditional kill ARMED at any archive-external g_lim < 8×10⁻³, adjudicable only externally, and the paper's Sec. XI/register (line 773) confirms the terminal menu: adopt the R-enhanced rate and face g_lim, or route (c) 'at the printed cost of the line-support theorem'.

verdicts.point_title: The original corpus systematically inflated [DF] grades; its current honesty is the campaign's product, not the authors'
verdicts.reason: Every specific instance checks out: F.1's convexity proof false by strict machine-verified counterexample (F-R13, paper App. F.1 erratum and h33 Part A); W1 'conserved exponential' NOT-AUDITABLE-FROM-TEXT as theorem; W5's gate forward implication a quantifier gap (enumeration over proposals ≠ POVM-class exclusion); VI.1's positivity premise 'asserted, not derived' (G2); the c″ stratified extension citing an archived TN series absent from the archive (T2 lines 236, 578); and the clock-identity R4 flag 'to-be-derived or declared constitutive postulate' (paper line 349). But the generalization overruns: the quoted 'theory-core survey' line ('the ORIGINAL v2.0.1 systematically over-graded') could not be located anywhere in the archive; and the claim that current honesty is 'the campaign's product, not the authors'' ignores that substantial self-critical discipline is original to the corpus (the F12 consistent-not-forced flag, the print-your-own-defects/escrow rules, the WS-B demotion protocols), and that many load-bearing [DF] grades survived audit intact (C₆ Haar constant, VIII.1, B.2, the ¼ invariant).
verdicts.correction: Restate as: audits found repeated instances (at least six, across four sectors) of theorem-grade typography on underived or false premises, corrected only by campaign-made repairs; the v4.3 ledger's honesty is partly retrofitted. Drop 'systematically' and the unlocatable survey quote, and concede the corpus's own pre-existing self-flagging discipline.

verdicts.point_title: The foundations positioning is structurally unfalsifiable: absorbable nulls, an idealized-screen conditional, and an undemonstrated far-field null
verdicts.reason: Most legs verify: FOUNDATIONS_ANALYSIS 2.3 shows GUM's no-signalling as 'Lock 1, equilibrium-contingent (the unlock VIII.E is a feature)' vs GRWm 'law-level, unconditional'; L7a/L7b carry the identical caveat verbatim ('assumes the idealized non-perturbing screen... A physical absorbing detector back-reacts and is itself POVM-describable'; 'Π < 1.5e-3 at 95% CL, not Π = 0'); L5prime G4 is FAIL-AT-d25 with p = 9.9e-8, no d in the scan reaching p > 0.05, and 'no such run was scored — the gate is graded FAIL at its own spec' (line 147); M4 measured 17×/41× faster Nelson relaxation making the dBB-calibrated relic windows optimistic. But the O-1 claim is contradicted at its own citation: Q2/ANALYTIC_RECON.md says 'the only identified technology is the Q1 validated-enclosure covering' — a technology IS identified (computational, not asymptotic); the true quote is only that 'no asymptotic argument can supply' O-1. And 'no scheduled test' for the positive signature sits uneasily beside F-T6-4's finding that the foliation is 'attached to a scheduled detection program with a pre-registered five-branch decision tree' (Layer 2, IX.C).
verdicts.correction: Replace the O-1 sentence with: O-1 cannot be discharged by asymptotic argument and its only identified route is the Q1 validated-enclosure covering (numerical certification, not an analytic theorem). Qualify 'no scheduled test': the foliation-signature side has a scheduled pre-registered program; it is the relic-window side that lacks one and is now 17-41× tighter under M4.

verdicts.point_title: Process: 'external replication' is not independent — one actor class writes the corpus, the tests, the verdicts, and the folds
verdicts.reason: MANIFEST_tier6.json confirms all campaign workflows (tier 6 and 7) are subagent runs of one coordinator session (536b52e3...), in the same repository that contains the corpus, corpus2, and corpus3 editions; REVISION_CHARTER_v2.md confirms the replicators produce the editions. 09-Record sec 1 calls this 'the first outside re-derivation' while nothing in the archive shows any human or organizationally distinct party re-running anything. Self-adjudication is documented: TIER6 shows '2 PARTIAL→converted by L5′' and 'magnitude under an arbitrarily placed bar'; TIER7 prints coordinator-owned spec defects for M1, M4, N3, and P2 ('fourth informative pre-registration failure of the tier', line 281), with failed pre-registered gates reclassified as coordinator spec artifacts by the same coordinator. PROGRAM_ANALYSIS_T7 line 120-121 states verbatim 'the trail's value is exactly the fraction of it that outsiders have re-derived' — and within the archive that fraction is zero.

verdicts.point_title: Process: the findings are terminally undischargeable — the counterparty does not exist, the replicators now write the corpus, and 'complete' never means complete
verdicts.reason: DISCHARGE_PACKAGE/README route (a) is 'Produce the frozen ⟨r1⟩ code' (line 306) and the package declares itself 'a success under exactly one condition: that you run it' (line 469; also 09-Record line 54) — an author counterparty that has never appeared anywhere in the archive. REVISION_CHARTER_v2 confirms replicators produce the corpus3 editions ('replicators' proposal, not the authors' edition') which are de facto the current corpus of record absent any authors, and REPLICATION_CAMPAIGN_STATUS line 321 confirms 'two stale' sentences found in the campaign's own corpus2 revision (the J2 'twenty-fold' defect is explicitly 'a defect of THIS revision, not of v2.0.1'). Status-language supersession is documented: 'Campaign status: COMPLETE (Tiers 0-5a...)' (line 230), 'ledger FINAL at F-R1–F-R16' (SESSION_HANDOFF ~line 141), 'PHASE K COMPLETE; NOTHING SCHEDULED REMAINS' (~line 294) — each followed by F-R17, Tiers 6-7, and Phases L-R. (Some 'COMPLETE' statements were tier-scoped, but 'ledger FINAL' was unscoped and superseded.)

verdicts.point_title: Process/scope: reproducibility headlines and the 'one action' framing both overrun their support
verdicts.reason: FRESHNESS.md header confirms single host, single toolchain, warm/incremental builds, with no cross-host attempt anywhere; its findings list exactly the claimed defects: F1/K36 and F5/K28 CMD-DEFECTs (printed commands that do not run), F6/K42 runtime wrong 51× (55 s printed vs 2814 s measured), F9/K14 truncated shipped log, F8/K29 PYTHONHASHSEED hang hazard (5.6 h CPU, killed) — all found only by the post-ship gauntlet. The census mismatch is real: 09-Record sec 3 counts 4 substantive / 5 moderate / 7 print-level-minor, while REPLICATION_CAMPAIGN_STATUS (~line 310) counts 4 substantive / 1 moderate / 5 print-level-minor over the same F-R1-F-R17 ledger. MANIFEST_tier6.json's note says it 'covers the tier6-foundations session only' while its own contents include workflow4-9 (Tier-7 phases M-R) — false by its own contents. The paper's abstract retains the eight-pillar 'From one action we obtain' framing while V.F grades α 'quantitatively unclaimed', VII.J's Honest residue says 'quark termination is not derived... base scales (m̃_t, m̃_b) are inputs... F-Q2′ is the sector's wall', and VII.I marks neutrino 'multiplicity... input-grade' — honestly labeled internally, not reflected in the headline framing. The 'minor' weight is appropriate since FRESHNESS's bottom line (zero physics drift, bit-identical) is itself accurately reported.
